about: The classes that can wear an item, for the items of ForeverDB's pools the game restricts to some: ForeverDB sorts its pools by armor type, so a Rogue's tier piece is in every leather wearer's. Read from WoWSims Forever's item database (classAllowlist, the game files' own class mask). ladders.full_ladder leaves an item out of the lists of a class that is not named here.
